Ahmad A. Abed Holding vs Ahmad A. Abed shared one Zoho ID with opposite verdicts from two verification passes; synced to the better-evidenced (Held) verdict. Aldawaa pharmacies (Held) was the same 900+-branch chain already captured cleanly as Yes under Al-Dawaa Medical Services Co.; resolved as duplicate (No).
Naqi water | نقي للمياه merged into NAQI نقي (both Held, same company, more complete evidence kept).

57 No-tagged accounts re-verified against the full gate ruleset with live-fetch/web-search evidence, replacing the bare non-retail-NAICS-only stub reason. 5 flipped to Yes (Kadoon Company via K.Cosmetics; Alyasra Foods via Makani Foods; Abu Khalifa Trading via Keakado.com; شركة صقر الجزيرة via jzfstore.com; WISTER, a 14-branch Jeddah QSR chain blocked by a domain typo). 52 confirmed No with real evidence.

net_effect: Yes 292 -> 297, No 868 -> 863 (net across all fixes), Held 105 (net unchanged across fixes, composition changed).
